name: stochastic-parrots-and-beyond
description: Open educational resources for the workshop Stochastic Parrots and Beyond: Normative Dimensions of Generative AI
author: Moritz Mähr <moritz.maehr@gmail.com>

scripts.check: prettier --check . && uv run ruff check && uv run ruff format --check && uv run ty check && uv run pytest
scripts.site:build: uv run quarto render --to html && uv run quarto render contents/slides --to revealjs
scripts.release:prepare: npm run site:build && npm run site:archive -- --stage
